atmosphere: A cleared artisan workshop where the weaving frame stands stripped of every thread, leaving only pale ash wood and open air to celebrate the absence of clutter.
material_language: Pale ash wood with visible grain, smooth plaster floor, matte woven cord resting on a bare wooden beam, all chosen for their honest craft texture.
lighting_intent: Soft directional light enters from the left, raking across the pale ash uprights and illuminating the plaster floor while the right side of the frame recedes into quiet shadow.

narrative_elements.element: Tall pale ash wood uprights forming a rhythmic skeletal frame in the background
narrative_elements.reason: The bare loom structure embodies the central idea of an empty weaving frame celebrating the absence of loose cords

narrative_elements.element: Horizontal ash wood tension bars crossing between the uprights
narrative_elements.reason: These bars complete the dismantled weaving apparatus described in the story, proving the fabric is finished

narrative_elements.element: A single short length of matte woven cord resting on the lowest wooden beam
narrative_elements.reason: This trace recalls the braided texture of the concept, echoing the historical craft metaphor without competing

permitted_secondary_elements: Smooth pale plaster floor extending under the wooden frame
Faint dust motes suspended in the left-side light beam

rationale: A stripped wooden weaving frame stands behind the FC-02 battery, its bare ash uprights proving that all necessary connections are already integrated, making the viewer feel the mental lightness of carrying twenty thousand mAh at forty-five watts without extra cords.
